Description
Welcome to TEDI-London. We believe it’s time to rethink engineering education. Not just to improve engineers’ futures, but to make life better for everyone. When we opened, we began training the engineers of the future; people with the ingenuity and enterprise to use engineering to leave the world a better, fairer place. We’re delighted to now partner with Kaplan International Pathways to bring TEDI-London to a global student audience.
